commands.viltrumitecore.chitauri.already: A Chitauri invasion is already running (/chitauri status)

commands.viltrumitecore.chitauri.ending: The portal begins to collapse: the invasion is ending
commands.viltrumitecore.chitauri.stopped: Chitauri invasion stopped: every Chitauri is gone and the portal is closed
commands.viltrumitecore.chitauri.no_wave: No wave can be sent in this phase
commands.viltrumitecore.chitauri.wave_se: The next Chitauri wave is on its way
commands.viltrumitecore.chitauri.unknown: Unknown phase: %s (opening, ground, air, leviathan, climax, closing)

viltrumitecore.chitauri.subtitle.opening: A Chitauri portal is forming over the city
viltrumitecore.chitauri.subtitle.ground: Chariots are dropping soldiers on the streets and roofs
viltrumitecore.chitauri.subtitle.leviath: Living warships are coming through the portal
viltrumitecore.chitauri.subtitle.climax: Everything the portal has left is pouring out
viltrumitecore.chitauri.subtitle.closing: The link to the hive is breaking
viltrumitecore.chitauri.subtitle.leviath: A colossal living warship emerges from the portal
viltrumitecore.chitauri.chat.opening: A blue beam strikes the sky above the city. Something is coming through.
viltrumitecore.chitauri.chat.ground: Chitauri chariots are landing troops. Protect the citizens!
viltrumitecore.chitauri.chat.air: Chitauri gunships attack from every direction!
viltrumitecore.chitauri.chat.leviathan: The Leviathans are here. Bring them down before they tear the city apart!
viltrumitecore.chitauri.chat.climax: The portal is sending everything it has. Hold the line!
viltrumitecore.chitauri.chat.closing: The portal is collapsing! The Chitauri are losing their link to the hive.
viltrumitecore.chitauri.chat.ended: Invasion repelled: %s soldiers, %s chariots and %s Leviathans destroyed; %s blocks of the city destroyed.
viltrumitecore.chitauri.chat.first_chari: Chariots are pouring out of the portal!
